citation: This research has made use of the SIMBAD database, operated at CDS, Strasbourg, France.
coverage: Messier 1 through Messier 110 exactly once; raw SIMBAD identity, object type and ICRS J2000 evidence plus reviewed modern observing-target entity type, target scope and coordinate role.
terms_or_licence: CDS SIMBAD terms and acknowledgement apply; derived reviewed snapshot redistributed with CDS attribution under ODbL-1.0.
usage_notes: Exact normalized CSV is 110 rows and 16889 bytes. Coordinates are ICRS J2000.0 decimal degrees. Raw SIMBAD otype values remain provider evidence; canonical entity type and target scope are review-pinned modern observing-target semantics. Coordinates are provider-record catalogue anchors, not asserted geometric target centres. The v2 release supersedes v1 selections without rewriting v1 evidence.
